title: 空间站被困且无法支付罚款
description: 因无法出售废料支付法律费用而被困在空间站，且未付罚款无法离开。
evidence: I've gotten stuck on a station forever because I couldn't sell my scrap for enough to pay my legal bills and they won't let you leave if you have outstanding fines.
